description.en: Sets the shirt numbers of the party members in one go: element i of the array is the number of party list entry i. Then every one of the first 16 entries left without a number (0) gets the lowest number not used yet.
One shirt number per party list entry, in list order.

examples.case: Renumbering the team (real usage, from ev42020200.nut; the array is shortened here)
